item.description:
News pill + survey polish

The Dashboard news banner now starts as a glossy green "New" pill — tap to expand into the full card. Skip + × dismiss it permanently. The tester-feedback page at halinskiy.github.io/3mpq-studio/#/corder-survey is rebuilt from Corder's own design tokens.

Custom update window, news banner, theme picker

The Sparkle update sheet is now a Corder-branded modal with a 3D entrance and a starfield backdrop, one big Update button.

Dashboard gets a dismissible News banner above "Ready when you are." — first item is the tester survey at 3mpq.studio/corder-survey.

Theme picker moved into General Settings as a three-option block (Follow system / Light / Dark) with the cursor-origin radial wipe. Profile name is editable inline in the popover and replaces "you" / "I" everywhere transcripts surface a speaker label. Test-mode Upgrade picks Pro or Max via a secondary dropdown. Gemini Flash is gone from the picker — Free is local-only, Pro/Max get Whisper Cloud.

Chapters, theme switch in Settings, Whisper-only cloud, profile rename

Chapters tab now matches Summary 1:1 — h3 timestamp pill, body title, divider between chapters. New "Generate / Regenerate" buttons let you build chapters on demand for old recordings.

Theme toggle moved out of the toolbar into General Settings as a real switch row. Profile rename — click your name in the popover to edit; new transcribes use it everywhere "you" used to appear (and existing transcripts substitute it on the fly).

Gemini Flash removed from the picker. Free → local Whisper; Pro/Max → Whisper Cloud. Stale `gemini` overrides coerce back to the tier default.

Download redesigned as a single bordered card (dropdown + green Download CTA). Active session in dark theme renders white text on the green fill (was unreadable). Breadcrumb updates instantly on session switch. Welcome wizard re-opens when mic/screen permission gets revoked.

App icon with depth

Previous icon read as a flat white sticker on dark Dock backgrounds — the squircle filled the entire 1024-px canvas with no margin for a shadow. Rebuilt against the Apple Icon Template (824-px squircle on a 1024 canvas, 100-px outer margin) and baked a soft drop-shadow into the alpha. The icon now sits on the Dock like a real macOS app on every theme.

App icon + installer fixes

Icon — on macOS Sonoma / Sequoia the Dock used to render only two black bars on transparency, because the iconset had no white squircle plate baked in (Tahoe drew its own; older macOS did not). Regenerated from the canonical brand SVG, looks identical on every macOS now.

Installer DMG — the 0.13.23 DMG itself was unsigned, so a fresh download from the website triggered Gatekeeper's "Move to Trash" prompt. The DMG container is now signed, notarized, and stapled alongside the app inside it.

Polish — body text nudged from #0E0E0D to #212121 (softer black on white panels); profile-avatar outline no longer breaks behind the half-moon / diagonal glyph variants.

Also includes 0.13.23 — Help-improve-Corder telemetry is now ON by default during the test period. Toggle in Settings, off = nothing leaves your Mac.

Help-improve-Corder telemetry (opt-in)

New toggle in Settings, OFF by default. When on, Corder ships a tiny diagnostic envelope once per 24h: app version, macOS version, Mac model, RAM, tier, and aggregate counts (meetings transcribed, ready vs failed, cloud vs local). Email is SHA-256-hashed into an anonymous id before anything leaves the Mac. No transcripts, no audio, no raw email. Stored in a Cloudflare D1 database the maintainer can query for continuous health signal without having to ask every user to tap the Bug icon.

Theme switch tooltip reads the action

"Dark theme" when you're in light, "Light theme" when you're in dark — same pattern Apple uses across System Settings. No more abstract "Toggle light/dark theme" that didn't tell you what was about to happen.

Bug-report rate limit

The Bug icon now refuses to fire more than once per hour. A spammed click surfaces "You can send a new report in ~X min." instead of mailing the maintainer 50 copies of the same log.

Free avatar background — actually free now

The toolbar and popover-header avatars hard-coded a CSS background: var(--accent), which was winning against the 0.13.18 tier-aware SVG fill — so a Free user still saw a green chip with a black glyph. Background removed; the SVG paints its own (accent for Pro / Max, transparent + outline for Free).

Failed-transcription toast

When the pipeline can't finish a transcription (model load failed, OOM, on-device WhisperKit ran out of memory), an in-app toast in the Library window now tells you what happened and what to do. If the cause was the on-device model not fitting, the toast points you at Settings → Transcription model to pick a lighter Whisper variant.

Send-a-bug-report with Undo

Click the Bug icon → a toast at the bottom counts down 10 seconds with an Undo button (same UX as Archive). The log is only sent when the countdown elapses, so an accidental click never leaves your Mac.

Smarter default Whisper variant on small Macs

Fresh installs on Macs with ≤ 8 GB RAM now default to the Base Whisper model (~150 MB, ~500 MB RAM at inference) instead of Turbo (1.5 GB on disk, ~3 GB RAM → swap-thrashes 8 GB M1s). The picker still lets you upgrade to Turbo.

Sign-in CTA in the profile popover

When the account is signed out the popover now reads "Not signed in" and offers a Sign-in button instead of pretending you're already logged in.

Tier-aware avatar

Pro / Max → canonical accent-green chip with a white glyph. Free → transparent surface with a dark glyph and a hairline outline (mirrors the secondary-button treatment).

Update pill cleaner + more eager

Label is now just "Update available" — no version number. The pill also surfaces faster: the React UI nudges Sparkle to do a silent appcast check whenever it doesn't yet have a verdict, so the pill no longer waits up to a day for Sparkle's 24h scheduled check.

New: Chapters tab

Every meeting view now has a third tab next to Transcript and Summary — Chapters. Gemini Flash Lite splits the finished transcript into 3–8 topical chapters with [mm:ss] timestamps; clicking a row seeks the audio scrubber. Generated server-side after each successful transcribe when Auto-chapters is on (new toggle in Settings, on by default). Routes through the same Cloudflare Worker proxy as transcribe / title / summary, so Pro / Max users don't need a local Google API key.

Whisper Cloud polish for Pro / Max — fixed

WhisperCleanup (gpt-4o-mini second-pass polish on Whisper Cloud output) was silently returning unchanged turns whenever the local OpenAI key file was absent — same root cause as the Whisper transcribe path before 0.13.12. It now routes through the same Cloudflare Worker proxy with JWT auth and the server-side key, so the polish stage actually runs for signed-in Pro / Max users.

Cloud audio backup temporarily off

Supabase Storage Free rejects single-shot uploads over 50 MB, so every recording's system.wav (~80 MB on a 7-min call) was failing 413 each cycle. Recordings now stay local-only; transcripts still sync to Supabase. Will flip back on the moment we migrate the audio bucket to Cloudflare R2 (no per-file cap, ∞ egress, free 10 GB).

Auto-title and auto-summary now work for Pro / Max

Both helpers (GeminiTitler + GeminiSummarizer) used to require the local Google API key file in ~/.config/corder/gemini_key and silently no-opped without it. They now route through the same Cloudflare Worker proxy as the transcribe path — server-side Google key, JWT auth, gated by app_metadata.tier. Pro / Max meetings will get titles + summaries automatically again.

SupabaseSync foreign-key error — actually fixed

0.13.8 reduced the noise but didn't eliminate the segments_speaker_id_fkey violation on every successful transcribe: speaker UUIDs were being resolved twice via UUID(uuidString: s.id) ?? UUID(), which yields a fresh random UUID each call when the local id isn't a valid UUID string. Speakers landed with one random, segments pointed at another, FK barfed. The two sides now agree.

Gemini cloud transcription works out of the box too

Following 0.13.12 (which did the same for Whisper Cloud), Gemini Flash now runs through the Cloudflare Worker as well — full Files-API upload chain + generateContent proxied with a server-side Google key, gated by app_metadata.tier. Pro / Max users can pick either cloud provider in the Dashboard picker and have it just work, with no ~/.config/corder/ files to manage. Free-tier still transparently falls back to on-device Whisper when a cloud provider is selected without entitlement.

Cloud Whisper works out of the box for Pro / Max

Corder no longer ships its own OpenAI key, and Pro / Max users no longer need to drop one into ~/.config/corder/openai_key. The audio goes through corder-api.empqwork.workers.dev/transcribe/whisper, the Cloudflare Worker holds the OpenAI key server-side, and your subscription tier (read from app_metadata.tier) is the gate. Free-tier users transparently fall back to on-device Whisper as before.

Failed transcription with no API key — fixed

If a cloud provider was picked but its API key wasn't on disk, the meeting failed with noKey. The pipeline now detects the missing key BEFORE the call and silently falls back to on-device Whisper for the run (same code path as the monthly-cap fallback).

Pro / Max auto-default to cloud Whisper

When the server applies the pro or max tier from app_metadata, Corder now switches the default transcription provider to cloud Whisper for that account — Pro users no longer sit on the on-device default by accident.

Rating prompt stops pestering

Shows at most ONCE per user, pinned to the first meeting it appeared on — closing the X or sending feedback dismisses it forever. Revisiting that meeting later or opening any other meeting never re-surfaces it. Threshold also moved back from 1 to 3 ready transcripts so the prompt doesn't fire on a test recording.

App icon size

Rolled back the dark-mode icon Asset Catalog from 0.13.10 — Tahoe was applying its own squircle mask on top and the icon rendered inset. Reverted to the canonical .icns at full size; we'll bring dark-mode polish back when we migrate the icon to Apple's new .icon manifest format.

App icon stays canonical in dark mode

macOS Tahoe (26+) auto-tints legacy .icns icons to near-black on dark backgrounds — the Corder squircle was disappearing into the menu bar / Dock. We now ship an Asset Catalog with explicit dark + light variants pointing at the same canonical white squircle, so the system uses our copy instead of the auto-tinted one. Logo stays white in every appearance.

Dashboard cleanup

Hid the Monthly usage card for now — re-enabled when paid plans go live and per-tier caps mean something again. The Bug-icon button still ships logs to the maintainer, the model picker still ships under Start; only the usage rollup is gone from the Dashboard for the moment.

Bug reports now structured

Submit-logs reports now also land as GitHub Issues in a private maintainer inbox (alongside the existing email), so triage isn't bottlenecked on inbox scrolling and long logs aren't lost mid-quote.

First-launch crash on tester Macs — fixed

Off-dev installs were SIGTRAP'ing within ~1 second of launch ("could not load resource bundle"). SwiftPM's auto-generated Bundle.module accessor was looking for the resource bundle at the .app root instead of Contents/Resources/ and fatal-erroring on the very first read. Routed through a custom resolver that checks all the realistic paths and gracefully returns nil instead of trapping.

Remote subscription tier

At sign-in Corder now reads app_metadata.tier from your Supabase user and applies it locally. Pro / Max can be granted server-side without running defaults write on the user's Mac.

Dashboard cold start = Start + model picker

A brand-new install shows only "Ready when you are." + the Start button + the new model picker. Stats and Monthly usage reveal themselves after 10 minutes of use, on first relaunch, or as soon as you have at least one recording — and stay revealed forever.

Model picker always under Start

One chevron pill lists every cloud provider (Gemini Flash / Whisper Cloud) AND every local Whisper size. Switch with a single click; if the local variant isn't on disk yet, the picker flips to the familiar download progress bar until it lands.

Send a bug report button

New Bug icon in the toolbar, left of the theme toggle. One click sends the tail of your log to the maintainer with your email + Corder version + macOS version attached — no Terminal required.

Avatar shuffle

The 3×3 avatar picker is gone; one click on the avatar in the profile popover rolls a fresh random glyph (with a Shuffle hover overlay). Choice persists across launches.

SupabaseSync FK violation

Fixed the recurring segments_speaker_id_fkey error on every successful transcribe. Speakers and segments now upsert in a single ordered task so segments can never land before their referenced speakers.

Per-tier caps restored

Free 1h / Pro 25h / Max unlimited per month. The 0.13.6 hard 60-min cap for every tier was a temporary test stub.

Monthly usage card polish

The two rows under "Monthly usage" now read as a continuation of the Stats card above — same typography, no progress pills. Layout: Advanced transcription on the left, "59 min left" / "unlimited" on the right. Cleaner at a glance, and easier to scan alongside Recordings / Total recorded / This week.

Dashboard scrollbar

The custom overlay thumb on the Dashboard left column now tracks the visible viewport height — previously it could extend past the column up to the window header when the column grew taller than its row. Right-column padding also matches the left now (was 22 px, now 20 px to align with everything else).

Monthly usage card on the Dashboard

Two new progress bars under your recording stats: Advanced transcription (cloud minutes, capped per plan) and Local Models (always unlimited). The bars start full and drain as you transcribe — the right side shows how much you have left.

Cap + auto-fallback to on-device Whisper

When the monthly cloud quota is exhausted, the next recording silently transcribes through the on-device model — no error, no manual switch. For this release the cap is a flat 60 minutes for every tier so the fallback path is testable; tier-specific caps come back with paid plans.

Transcribing timer reads from the backend

The elapsed counter under "Transcribing…" now reflects when the pipeline actually started, not when you happened to open the meeting view. No more "00:00" every time you switch to a session that's been running for a while.

Smaller fixes

Selecting a meeting then returning to the Dashboard now clears the sidebar's highlight (was sticking on the last opened row). The rating prompt drops the email field (we use your signed-in email automatically) and the Skip button (close via the X), leaving Send as the single primary CTA.

Sign In / Sign Up auto-detect in the Welcome wizard

The sign-in step now figures out whether your email belongs to an existing account before you submit and swaps the title between Sign In and Sign Up with a soft squeeze animation (same easing as the recording pill on the landing page). For new emails a Confirm password field slides in beneath Password — no more silent account creation when you mistype credentials.

Google sign-in success page

The "You're signed in" page in your browser now uses the dot-grid background from 3mpq.studio, and both header marks are clickable: 3mpq → studio, Corder → getcorder.com.

Local Whisper tokenizer fix

WhisperKit init no longer dies with Tokenizer configuration is missing on the first transcribe. The pipe init now allows the SDK to fetch the tokenizer sidecar (it lives in a different HF repo from the Core ML packages); already-downloaded model files are reused.

Sidebar status reads honest

Rows whose backend status is transcribing no longer wear a pulsing gold dot — it falsely implied the pipeline was actively working even after it stopped (auto-transcribe off, post-launch stalls, etc.). They show a hollow circle now; the "transcribing" word is gone from the meta line.

Profile menu: Check for updates

New row in the avatar popover that forces Sparkle to re-fetch the appcast immediately, instead of waiting on its lazy ~24 h schedule.

Whisper model auto-prefetch + Dashboard picker

On-device Whisper Turbo (1.5 GB) now starts downloading silently on first launch — no more 3-5 min cold start when you record the first call. The first time you press Start, a progress pill appears under the Dashboard primary button; once the model is on disk it morphs into a permanent variant picker (Turbo / Small / Base / Tiny). Same control, single source of truth — the duplicate picker in Settings is gone.

Google sign-in landing page

The Welcome wizard's Continue with Google now redirects to a styled in-app success page (3mpq + Corder marks, ⌘W hint) instead of leaving the browser hanging on Google's account chooser. (Project owners: add http://127.0.0.1:** to Supabase → Authentication → URL Configuration → Redirect URLs so the loopback passes the allowlist.)

Welcome sign-in: per-field errors

"Sign in with email" is always brand-green active. Bad input lights up red borders + inline captions under the offending field, instead of greying out the CTA.

Header drag — finally rock solid (recap from 0.13.1)

If you missed the previous build: the whole header is a native drag region. Click-to-rename + every toolbar button keep working through a hit-test that pulls live bounding rects of the React buttons from the page. Drag works in every pixel — between buttons, over breadcrumb text, down to the bottom border.

PopoverShell + settings cleanup

Menu-bar popover geometry now lives on a single PopoverShell token set so the main popover and the meeting-invite surface stay byte-identical when one number moves. Settings reorganised: Auto-transcribe / Auto-title / Auto-summary moved above Microphone; the Transcription model card lives only under the Dashboard now. API access + Delete account descriptions trimmed. Settings toolbar gear is now a toggle.

Misc

Empty Library on first launch (the canned demo rows are gone). Idle subtitle shortened to "Start a recording in the background." Recording subtitle shortened to "Corder keeps recording in the background." Menu-bar popover layout tightened — 8 pt closer to the divider on both sides. corder-mcp published to npm.

Tooltips on more buttons

Same 350 ms delay + design-system chip is now on the transcript-toolbar Clarify (Users) button, the Archive sidebar Restore action, the video fullscreen Close, and the Update pill — matches what the header toolbar already had.

Tooltip click suppression — everywhere

Clicking any Tooltip-wrapped trigger hides the chip instantly and suppresses re-show until the cursor leaves and comes back. No more chip floating over a button that's already mid-click.

Header drag — rock solid at last

Replaced the old hybrid (28 pt native strip + async JS bridge for the rest) with a single full-coverage native overlay. The page reports the exact bounding rect of every interactive toolbar button via a headerHits bridge, and the overlay's hit-test passes events through only over those rects. Drag works in every other pixel — between buttons, over breadcrumb text, all the way down to the bottom border — while hover and click on the real buttons stay native.

Tooltips stop lingering after click

Clicking a toolbar button now hides the tooltip instantly and suppresses it until the cursor leaves and comes back. No more chip floating over the button while the theme or archive is already switching.

API access + MCP token in Settings

New "API access" card shows your personal token for integrating Corder with Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT desktop, or direct REST API calls. One click copies the token to your clipboard.

MCP server @corder/mcp

Published Node package with MCP tools: list_meetings, get_meeting, search_transcripts, get_summary, list_speakers. Any MCP client now sees your meetings natively. Row-level security in Supabase keeps access scoped to you.

Toolbar tooltips

Settings, Archive, Theme switch, Copy, Refresh, Fullscreen — every header control now has a quick hint (350 ms delay) styled to the design system.

Archive disables when empty

The Archive button in the header is now disabled when you have no archived meetings — tooltip switches to "Archive is empty" on hover.

Email/password — real Supabase Auth

The welcome wizard's email/password path now creates a real Supabase account on first sign-in (sign-in → fallback to sign-up on first attempt).

Header drag — finally rock solid

The whole left side of the header is now a native draggable region. Click-to-rename on the breadcrumb still works via synthetic click forwarding. No more "drag only works in random spots."

Cloud sync

Meetings, speakers, segments, summaries, and audio are now mirrored to Supabase. Sign in on a second Mac and your library is already there.

Per-account local storage

Each Google account on the same machine gets its own folder — multiple accounts can't see each other's recordings at the filesystem level.

Sign in via Supabase

Welcome wizard: Google OAuth + email/password through Supabase Auth. Sessions restore on launch, sign out / sign in switches accounts with an automatic restart.

Delete account

Red full-width button at the bottom of Settings, with confirmation. Wipes all meetings/speakers/segments/summaries and Storage files in the cloud plus local state.

Get help

Profile menu item opens getcorder.com/contact in the system browser.

Settings active state

The Settings icon in the header lights up when the Settings pane is open, mirroring how Archive lights up.

Notifications stop stacking

Each new Corder notification replaces the previous one in Notification Center instead of piling up.

Welcome email — only on first signup

The email used to fire on every Google sign-in. Now it sends once, and the logo in it has been updated.

Header drag fix

Clicks on breadcrumb / toolbar buttons are no longer swallowed by the drag zone. Title-bar strip back to 28 pt.

Local Whisper model size picker

Settings → Transcription model now offers four sizes: Turbo (1.5 GB), Small (480 MB), Base (150 MB), Tiny (75 MB). Below the dropdown there's a primary "Download model" button with an inline progress bar — you can pre-download any model and switch between them without a restart.

Language picker moved into Settings

It's now the third block next to Microphone and Transcription model — same "label + desc + dropdown" pattern. The language switcher is no longer duplicated in the header.

Custom dropdowns replace native menus

Microphone and Transcription model selectors were redrawn as the same portaled popover used by LangPicker. Auto-flip upward when there's no room below — no more dropdowns getting clipped by the Settings panel edge.

Get help in profile menu

New menu item → mailto handoff to support. Menu grouped: Dashboard / Language / Settings on top, Get help / Sign out at the bottom.

Rating banner under the transcript

Once a transcript is ready, an inline prompt appears below it: 1–5 stars, an optional comment when the rating is ≤ 4, and an optional email.

Start recording — bolder type

The primary button in the menu-bar popover now renders at .regular weight instead of .light — matches the density of "Open library" below it.

DMG installer instead of ZIP

New styled DMG with an arc/arrow between the Corder and Applications icons. Developer ID signed and notarized.

Three transcription providers

Cloud Whisper (OpenAI whisper-1 + gpt-4o-mini polish) and local WhisperKit large-v3-turbo via Core ML join Gemini. The local path costs $0 after a one-time ~1.5 GB model download — Apple Silicon only. Intel transparently falls back to Gemini.

Welcome wizard and Google OAuth

Two-step onboarding on first launch: Microphone + Screen Recording with deep links into System Settings, then sign-in (email/password or Continue with Google via the system browser).

Dashboard as landing

Opening Library without an active session shows the dashboard: stats on the left, a sortable Recent list on the right (by duration, date, or speaker count), with a shared ResizeHandle from MeetingView.

20 UI languages

The Globe button in the header opens a popover with flags and a search field. Full translations: en, uk, ru, de, fr, es, pt, it, pl, cs, tr, nl, sv, id, vi, ja, ko, zh, hi, ar. Locales without a full dictionary fall back to English.

Auto-summary and Summary tab

Opt-in in Settings: after transcription Gemini produces a structured Granola-style summary alongside the transcript. Dedicated tab with a Copy / Refresh / Search toolbar.

Profile menu + avatars

Popover with 9 SVG avatar variants (3×3 picker), Dashboard jump, cross-surface Settings, Sign out.

Mark-as-viewed

Unseen recordings in the sidebar and Recent list show a gold title. Cleared automatically the first time you open them in a ready state.

Auto-archive of silent recordings

Recordings shorter than 60 s with no speech move straight to Archive (7-day retention) with a toast and a system notification.

Global recording shortcut

Default ⌘⇧F via Carbon RegisterEventHotKey — no Accessibility prompts. Reassignable in Settings.

Per-app recording filters

Whitelist / blacklist for the auto-record prompt: an installed-apps picker with real icons instead of typing bundle IDs by hand.

Total system-audio loss — fixed

A late Core Audio tap buffer after CaptureEngine.stop() used to re-create and truncate the already-written system.wav. Added a tearingDown flag — late buffers are dropped instead of truncating the file.

Echo in dual-track — fixed

Identical "you paraphrased their words" lines are no longer attributed to the far end — added an echoFiltered step on top of the mic.

BT far-end audio

Track selection (Core Audio tap vs SCStream backup) is now driven by voiced energy, not by the Bluetooth route flag.

Header drag via JS bridge

WKWebView no longer swallows mousedown — the window drags from any empty part of the header.

Notarized Developer ID build

Corder is now signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple — Gatekeeper no longer shows "can't be verified".

Welcome wizard

First-launch onboarding window: microphone, screen recording, and an email subscription field.

Paddle integration

Pro purchase now works through the checkout on getcorder.com.

Mic device picker

Settings lets you pick which microphone to record from (defaults to system).

Hide empty video

When a meeting's video isn't available (no file, not in Dropbox, or an old recording), the player no longer renders a black rectangle. The card collapses and audio controls move up into its place.

0 % CPU at idle

The blob's TimelineView no longer ticks when nothing's happening. Was ~10 % CPU in the background, now 0 %. Animation springs back to life on hover or while recording.

Pill busy state

After clicking the "Update available" pill it briefly pulses green while Sparkle opens its install dialog. The click used to give no visual feedback.

Pill actually appears

Sparkle now runs a silent background check 2 s after launch instead of waiting 24 h. The "Update available" pill lights up on a fresh install.

Pointer cursor on the blob

The floating blob's cursor reliably switches to the pointing hand — NSTrackingArea with mouseEntered/Exited push/pop.

Update pill

The green pill in the toolbar now shows the target update version and refreshes when the window regains focus.

Green update button

A green "Update available" pill appears to the left of the language switcher in the toolbar when Sparkle has pulled a newer version from the appcast. The pill carries a subtle sparkle effect and a periodic shine. Clicking it launches the standard install panel.

Archive no longer misaligned

Archive rows are aligned: consistent type heights, the "in 7 days" label pinned to the first line of the title, padding and grid brought to a single rhythm.

Video call auto-detect

When a known meeting app (Zoom, Teams, Meet, Slack, browsers in a web call) launches and the system microphone is held for more than three seconds, a blurred capsule pops up offering to start recording. Tap it and it morphs into the floating blob.

Screen recording

Corder now actually writes video.mov — HEVC, 15 fps, ~1.5 Mbps. The Library shows a silent preview above the audio player; audio drives the timeline.

Blob in the Library window

The button in the bottom-right is the same morphing SwiftUI blob the floating HUD uses. Click toggles recording, the floating blob gets out of the way while the Library is in focus.

Skeleton UI

The meeting list and detail panel render shimmer placeholders on first load instead of an empty surface or a flash of content.

Less lag

The blob's TimelineView dropped from 60 Hz to a state-driven 6–30 Hz and pauses when the window is hidden. React polling slowed down at idle (1 s → 5 s, 5 s → 15 s). MeetingDetector — 2 s → 4 s, the CoreAudio query is skipped when no meeting app is running. /api/meetings — N+1 → a single SQL query. Net result: background CPU is several times lower.

Cleaner playback

audio.wav (the full mic + system mix) is kept locally and the player picks it instead of mic-only — you finally hear the other side. Auto-detected meetings start with expectedOtherSpeakers=1, and the dual-track mapper collapses every Gemini label into a single Speaker 2 — no more 5 phantom speakers on a long 1:1 call.

Misc

The floating blob clamps to screen edges. Removed the Donate button and its plumbing, a dead Dropbox method, unused i18n keys, and CSS.

Dual-track Gemini transcription

Mic and system audio go to Gemini as two parallel calls now, mic forced to a single speaker, system asked to diarise the remote side. Solves the "your words got merged with your friend's during a silent gap" failure mode.

Floating recording HUD

Granola-style pill that hovers over every Space while you record. Pulsing dot, live EQ-style waveform, elapsed timer, one-click stop.

7-day archive bin

Sessions you don't want to see go to a soft-archive bin instead of being deleted. Restore or purge per row, or let the 7-day timer clean them up automatically.

Smart re-transcribe

Raw Gemini turns are cached by audio MD5. Re-mapping speakers and re-transcribing after a Dropbox archive both reuse the cache — zero extra API calls.

New app icon

Two glossy 3D pause bars on a warm-white radial ground. Cleared the old green-on-white logo from the icon cache.
